'''emperor of all Troopers''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[emperor of all]]
* '''Published:''' 1 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay)|CC-D-cloudcityeastplatformdockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Cloud City East Platform (Docking.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Desolate all.  Comments please.

The published list has 59 cards.

Play Vader and Troopers and beat them down, the Stormtroopers have as much power as vader.
